name: AiStatusStrip
description:
The conversation's status strip (R14.6, R17.4): the session stream's connection, the
budget and the model, as one caption line under the composer. Background state lives
here, never in a banner: "Reconnecting · attempt 2 · 4 s", "Offline · history stays
readable", "Daily allowance 82%" in the warning tone from 80%.
signature: ({ stream, retryAt, attempt, onRetry, budget, model, className, }: AiStatusStripProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: budget
props.description: Remaining capacity and its warning state.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: model
props.description: Selected assistant model or typed view model.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called from Retry now, shown whenever `stream` is not `connected` and this is supplied.

props.name: retryAt
props.description: Reconnecting: when the next attempt runs (Unix ms) and which attempt it is.
